div.head: II Cn 84.4b
div.ab: ⁊ á manna gehwylc to weorðunge his Drihtne do to góde þæt he mæge wordes ⁊ dæde glædlice æfre; þonne byð us eallum Godes milts þe gearwur.
And ha manna gehwilc to wyrðunge his Drihtne do to gode þæs þe he mæge wordes ⁊ dæde gledlice æfre; þonne bið us eallum Godes miltsa þe gearwera.
Et omnis homo semper ad honorem Creatoris sui faciat boni quod potest uerbo et opere hilariter usquo quaque; et tunc erit nobis eius misericordia preparatior.
And manna gehwylc to weorðunga his Drihtene do to gode þæt he mæge wordes ⁊ weorces ⁊ dæde glædlice æfre; ðonne byð us eallum God þe gearwera.
And a manna gehwylc to weorðunge his Drihtne do to gode þæt he mæge wordes and dæde glædlice æfre; þonne byð us eallum Godes milts þe gearwur.
Und stets thue jeder der Menschen seinem Herrgott zu Ehren immer freudig an Gutem was er kann in Wort (und Werk B) und That; dann wird uns allen Gottes Gnade (Gott B) um so bereitwilliger sein.
And let every person always, to the honour of his Lord God, joyfully do whatever good he can in word (and work, B) and deed; then God's mercy (God, B) will be the more ready for all of us.
And every man, for the honour of his Lord, shall always gladly do his utmost by word and by work and by deed for the furtherance of what is good; then shall God be the more ready [to help us].
And to honor the Lord, each person must always gladly do all that he can to promote righteousness by word and by deed; then will God’s mercy be the more certain for us all.
div.note: dæde: B adds and Godes milts: God B
